claim: The Aiguille du Midi cable car climbs from Chamonix to 3,842 m in about 20 minutes, a vertical gain of over 2,800 m, ticket roughly €75 round-trip.
quote: The cable car travels from Chamonix to the top of the Aiguille du Midi – an altitude gain of over 2,800 m – in 20 minutes... The Aiguille du Midi stands at 3,842 meters altitude

claim: Aiguille du Midi at 3,842 m offers full immersion into the heart of the Mont-Blanc massif via one of the world's most impressive cable cars, accessible to everyone.
quote: Aiguille du Midi - Cable car, Panoramic Mont-Blanc

claim: Megève to Annecy is about 92 km / roughly 1 hour by car; Chamonix is about 32.5 km (~45 min) from Megève.
The Tramway du Mont-Blanc runs daily 15 June–27 September 2026 from Saint-Gervais, reaching the Nid d'Aigle at 2,412 m; round-trip adult €34.70, child €28.50.
quote: From 15 June 2026 until 27 September 2026 - Open everyday... The trains now reach the Nid d'Aigle refuge at 2,412 meters elevation... Round-trip adult: €34.70

claim: The cogwheel tramway (open since 1909) now extends 300 m further to a new stabilised platform at the foot of the Nid d'Aigle refuge, with an observation deck over the Bionnassay glacier seracs.
quote: The trains will drop passengers off 300 meters further on, directly at the foot of the Nid d'Aigle refuge, at an altitude of 2,412 meters... a new observation platform allows visitors to admire the seracs of the Bionnassay glacier

claim: Lake Annecy has 13 swimmable beaches; on 3 June 2026 water was 20.1°C, averaging ~23°C in summer, so June swimming is feasible.
quote: On June 3, 2026, the water temperature was recorded at 20.1°C... in summer, the water temperature of Lake Annecy is an average of 23°

claim: Lake Annecy's ideal swimming season runs June–September, with boat, paddle, pedalo and electric-boat (no licence) rentals plus lake cruises available.
quote: the best time for a pleasant swim is from mid-June to early September... You can hire a boat, paddle, or pedalo... rent an electric boat on Lake Annecy without a license

claim: Combloux's chemical-free biotope swimming lake opens weekends from 13 June 2026 then daily from 22 June (10:30–19:00); entry ~€6.50–7.50 adult, with a 2,900 m³ plant-filtered pool and direct Mont Blanc panorama.
quote: June 13-14 & 20-21: Weekends only... June 22 - July 3: Daily... water free from chemical treatment, filtered by over 10,000 plants with a 2,900 m³ swimming area... direct Mont Blanc panorama

claim: Combloux's biotope was the first public biological swimming site in France (2002), fully rehabilitated in 2022, set a stone's throw from the village centre.
quote: the first biological swimming site in France to open to the public in 2002, and was completely rehabilitated in 2022

claim: Saint-Gervais's Les Bains du Mont-Blanc thermal spa closes for maintenance 26 May–5 June 2026, reopening 6 June; open year-round, until 9pm Fri/Sat and 7pm other days.
quote: technical closing from May 26th to June 5th 2026... the thermal baths are open on Fridays and Saturdays until 9pm, while the rest of the week the doors close at 7pm

claim: Cordon, the 'balcony of Mont-Blanc', sits 12 km / ~20 min from Megève with a 360° panorama from the Aravis to the Fiz ranges and over 80 km of marked hiking trails.
quote: Cordon is nicknamed the balcony of Mont-Blanc... an exceptional 360° panorama from the Aravis chain to the Fiz chain, with the Mont-Blanc range as the centerpiece... Over 80 km of marked hiking trails

claim: The Montenvers red rack railway from Chamonix and the Aiguille du Midi can both be done in a single day, but timing is tight and worth planning.
quote: Chamonix 2 excursions in 1 day - Aiguille Du Midi & Mer de Glace timing question
